newsitem.title: UK: Buenos Aires to raise up to $500 mln bonds - Chase.
newsitem.headline: Buenos Aires to raise up to $500 mln bonds - Chase.

text.p: The city of Buenos Aires will raise a total of $500 million via a bond issue possibly by the end of this week depending on market conditions, syndicate manager at Chase said on Tuesday.
"We are roadshowing in London on Wednesday and Geneva on Thursday and could launch the bonds soon after," he said.
One tranche is expected to be for $250 million with a 10-year maturity.
The other tranche will be for $250 million equivalent, denominated in pesos, with a five- or seven-year maturity.
"But we are still open to the size and maturity of the bonds," the Chase official said.
